title: Text and PACB produce the same frames
teaches: Pacer.load compiles the text; PacerRt.load decodes the packed carrier. For the same host join and the same seconds, the two paths must return bit-identical writes, including key anchors, expr evaluation, pattern haps and trigger lanes.
observe: The score mixes keys, expr, pattern, trigger, scene, control, tempo map and emit.
Both drivers are asked for the same six clocks.
Every write tuple, including its f32 hex bits, compares equal.
The binary path never sees the score text.
